verdict: No tested user-mode MFCreateVirtualCamera replacement transport passed the unchanged NV12 1920x1080 30fps contract. Request-credit pacing restored 1080p30 throughput and eliminated sequence skips but failed latency at 48.327ms p95. Reduced-mode characterization still identifies M2 source-owned slots at NV12 1920x1080 and 15fps as a mode-specific automated-gate candidate, not an accepted product constraint or transport selection.
